import math

def main():
    x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
    n = int(n)
    
    target = x / y
    numerator = 0
    denominator = 1
    bestError = 1e30
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        scaled = target * i
        candidates = [math.floor(scaled), math.ceil(scaled)]
        
        for cand in candidates:
            error = abs(target - cand / i)
            if error < bestError:
                bestError = error
                numerator = int(cand)
                denominator = i
    
    print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</translated_code>
